codes.meaning: The sensor that monitors the refrigerator compartment's air temperature has dropped out or started reporting erratic readings.
The sensor mounted on the refrigerator's evaporator coil has lost signal or begun giving inconsistent readings.
The refrigerator's compressor has been running far longer than it should, pointing to a cooling or airflow problem.
The relay that switches power to the refrigerator compressor has failed in the open position.
The refrigerator compressor's relay has failed in the closed position, leaving the compressor energized continuously.
A refrigerator-side fault logged on the Classic built-in control board.
The temperature sensor on the freezer evaporator has lost its signal or started returning inconsistent readings.
During a defrost cycle, the system never saw expected feedback confirming the defrost heater turned on.
The freezer's compressor has been cycling on for an abnormally long stretch.
The relay controlling power to the freezer compressor is stuck open.
The freezer compressor relay is stuck closed, so the compressor stays powered on continuously.
On the Classic built-in series, the freezer has been running continuously well past its normal cycle length.
